reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday predicate in shared/schedules and replaces every holidays.includes(...) check in shared/schedules.ts and server/schedules/app.ts with it.

duplication.why: Adds no new copies; the 'isWeekend || holiday' combination is still repeated at four sites as before, a chance to consolidate that was not taken.

placement.why: The matching rule lives in the shared schedules module next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend and is imported by the server.

scope.why: Focused on holiday matching, with some incidental prettier reflow of untouched lines in app.ts.

maintainability.why: Any future change to holiday entry formats now lands in one function; the repeated non-business-day lambdas remain a minor smell.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isHoliday
